No one will save you even if your throat is broken (No one will save you if you break your throat (page 22)) The two brothers Zhou Kun and Zhou Chen looked at Zhou Lulu and Zhou Xian nervously. From time to time, they glanced at Lu Zhan's face. But how much effect can Lu Shu's clone play? In fact, Lu Zhan was not sure whether he could show off his power like swallowing mutated mushrooms. The originally prosperous county was now in a state of mourning. The solid city walls were in dilapidated condition, the outside of the moat was filled with corpses, and the water source was flooded. Pollution, smelling of stench and disease. "Why can't you come with me?" Pei Wei asked in confusion, with a hint of anxiety in his tone. Unexpectedly, time has widened the gap between the two. Not only did she fail to catch up with the other party, but she was also left far behind. People who knew the inside story couldn't help but feel ridiculous and... a little sad for him. Their family was originally a famous family, and they were the only one to send them to this war. The sage family, which had gathered the most high-level combat power, participated in the battle in the name of protecting the human race. The air in the hall suddenly became silent, and you could hear a pin drop on the ground. What I didn't expect was that what I thought was a false alarm actually brought immeasurable consequences to me. Because the business of Lu's braised food stall was booming, it also attracted a lot of people, and the business of nearby shops also improved. At the same time, there was a faint feeling in my heart. There is an indescribable warmth in my heart, which is the feeling you get when someone cares about you and is loved by someone. Liu Feng and Liu Yu, you two are really deplorable for disobeying my mother and me. If Rong Ning finds out about her crime, everyone will be executed. He had wanted to use her before, and he had already used her. Would he still talk to him about everything like this? Gu Ling'er hid her entire body in the water, only her head was exposed, and the water just covered her lips.
